title: Satisfaction of the Tseitin Encoding
statement: Let $u$ be a Boolean assignment to the inputs of a Boolean circuit tree $C$. Assign each input variable its value under $u$ and each gate variable the value obtained by evaluating the circuit at that gate. Then every clause in the Tseitin encoding of $C$ is satisfied by this assignment.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables
